title: Binding Rules: *köteles*, *kötelezettségként*, *kógens*
grammar: Obligation in a text about the state
goal: I can say what the state or a rule obliges with *köteles* and *kötelezettségként*.
I can name two kinds of legal norm (*kógens norma*, *diszpozitív rendelkezés*).
I can write one short sentence about a duty of the state.

sections.title: Unit 25: Separation of Powers and the Order of Norms
body: This unit is about how public power is limited: some rules cannot be changed, a decree ranks below a statute, parliament and the government have different tasks, and institutions check each other.
The unit ends with a text about Eötvös József's book 'A XIX. század uralkodó eszméinek befolyása az államra' (1851), which is about the limits of state power.
